mechanism.claim: After a source-complete UTC day, same-direction normalized aggressive BTC taker flow in both Binance USDT and USDC quote books during an already elevated BVOL/DVOL regime identifies broad stablecoin-denominated price discovery; the consensus direction should relay for twelve hours.
mechanism.side: common sign of daily USDT and USDC normalized signed taker flow
mechanism.why_distinct: DSQFCR aggregates two complete quote books once per UTC day. VGSQF was an hourly USDC+FDUSD consensus with USDT lag; VGSFR required ordered propagation; SQFD used an unrestricted hourly diffusion clock.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: both BVOL and DVOL at the day boundary must exceed their causal 720-hour q60 levels
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: one daily 00:05 UTC stablecoin-flow consensus clock is absent from Gross9

clock.source_day: exact prior UTC day [D-24h,D), requiring all 24 hourly rows for BTCUSDT and BTCUSDC source_complete
clock.normalized_flow: sum(signed_taker_flow_btc)/sum(base_volume_btc), separately by quote book; denominator positive
clock.consensus: both normalized flows nonzero, same sign, and each absolute value>=0.05
clock.participation: USDC base-volume share of combined USDT+USDC base volume>=0.01
clock.volatile_regime: BVOL and DVOL closes available at D are each >= own strictly-prior 720h q60, requiring 672 valid hours
clock.decision: exact D 00:00 UTC after all source features complete
clock.reservation: fixed daily decisions; global half-open, exit first on equal open
clock.funding_oi: not signal inputs; exact funding only for later PnL

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding marks, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_bindings.spot_flow: hash-bound Binance stablecoin quote-flow panel through 2026-07-31
source_bindings.execution_price: sealed until source-support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent daily cross-denominator consensus mechanism with complete pre-entry sources

stopping_rule: Terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, strict economics; no threshold, side, hold, clock, or subset repair.
